title: Bar Drop Pineapple Peach Mango 10ml Nic Salts E-Liquid
description: Bar Drop Salts Pineapple Peach Mango by Drop is a sun-drenched medley of three distinct fruits. The sharp tang of pineapple opens the flavour, followed immediately by the soft, velvety sweetness of peach. The profile is rounded off by the rich, juicy depth of mango, creating a layered and harmonious tropical experience. This e-liquid is mixed with a 40% VG / 60% PG ratio, a specification chosen to maximise the intensity of the flavour concentrate. The higher PG level ensures each fruit note remains distinct rather than muddied. Designed for use with MTL (Mouth-to-Lung) pod kits, it utilises nicotine salts for a smooth throat hit in 5mg, 10mg, or 20mg strengths. Bar Drop Salts is a range of nic salt e-liquids from UK manufacturer, Drop, that specialises in creating fruity flavours of astonishing authenticity and clarity.
